decision: The exact five-file candidate is not approved for intake because of F01. No production source has been changed or copied into the candidate tree by this review.

findings.title: Raw numeric rateId can be discarded by the qualifier and incorrectly select an automatic rate
mechanism: runtime/planner.ts c487 versionOf maps both positions and rates through identified. identified converts numeric rateId to its string identity before calculated calls chosenRate.
port.ts 838 projectPlannerSource instead builds qualification.hc from rawHc and normalizes rates[].id only. rawHc.positions[].rateId remains numeric.
headcount-months.ts 7896 calls chosenRate with text(position.rateId). runtime/contract.ts b62 text returns an empty string for every non-string value.
chosenRate in planner-accounts.ts 6ca9 uses the explicit reference when nonempty and falls back to autoRate only when empty. The qualifier therefore changes the selection rule for numeric references.
fteInputsKnown stays true for the example: it verifies position identity, include and finite fte/start/end, but not rateId normalization. It does not block this path.

With a dangling numeric reference and a location-compatible card, the engine has no selected rate and contributes its legacy zero. The qualifier can choose the automatic card, find no missing-rate, and expose that same zero as a confirmed budget. A missing input becomes known zero.
findings.exampleScope: An illustrative stored Planner version for a source-level counterexample. It has not been inserted into a store or executed. Numeric identity normalization is explicitly supported by the existing runtime; no principal, binding, receipt, projection or result has been fabricated.

staticTrace.expectedQualification: The explicit dangling identity must remain unresolved. Budget and inherited outlook remain null/absent with missing-rate; the legacy computed zero may remain in the underlying domain view and must not be changed.
staticTrace.notClaimed: This trace does not claim that complete C10 or a persisted complete ScenarioResult is reached; the false confirmed budget cell is independently sufficient to reject the candidate.

minimumOwnerCorrection: Publish a whole producer file that preserves the same canonical identity normalization used by versionOf/identified before the private HR qualification. An explicit numeric rateId must never become an absent selector and trigger autoRate.

Keep raw presence checks separate from normalized identity lookup; retain aggregate-only egress, individual-data redaction, real domain formulas, role/lock rules and every current readPair/source/coverage/authority fence.

Include a focused hosted counterproof for a dangling numeric rateId with an auto-compatible card, plus controls for the same dangling string reference, a valid numeric reference, explicit known zero and independent actual/forecast. Exercise finance and viewer aggregate privacy without exposing raw rates.
Supply the exact commit/blob and GitHub Actions result. WP12 will review and consume that published file, never synthesize a foreign hunk combination.

The unchanged domain.view computes synthetic HR domain aggregates before recursive redaction. Its non-private view removes individual salary/cost/override/rates/rateId/increase and position annual/months/total/budget fields, while retaining the permitted domain-level summary aggregates.

Raw rate inputs are used only in a local qualification object. hrMonthStates returns bounded aggregate values and missing-state codes, not cards, rates, individual costs or overrides.

No prefix/version requirement rejecting source-scenario was found in the inspected persistence/consumer path.
